ana (vendor-liaison): Quick sync 1: vendors asked for a single cross-region embargo carrier for upcoming HW wave (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi). Need a map of blockers & a recommended stagger.
tom (partnerships): Partners prefer NA then EU then APAC. Biggest unknown is MI300 microcode window.
kevin (eng): MI300 microcode: vendor provisional date May 10. Gaudi driver image ready but needs final validation on our 6.1 kernel. H200 telemetry flag pending vendor sign-off.
harper (marketplace): Note: marketplace requires 14-day lead for verified images + per-region metadata. Also image-verification backlog ~36-48h.
sylvia (solutions): For SI integrations: require perf cert, driver matrix, and a dry-run day in our staging cluster. Recommend we publish two perf baselines if MI300 has patch lag.\tana (typo correction): ana -> ana (vendor-liaison) :)
nana (oops): ignore
ana2 (ignore): ignore
ana (vendor-liaison): Proposed schedule: NA announce wk May 20, EU wk Jun 3, APAC wk Jun 17. Two-week buffers.
tom (partnerships): That works if May 10 microcode is firm. Fallback: announce H100/H200/B200 + "MI300 coming soon" placeholder to avoid blocking.
kevin (eng): Technical risk: kernel bump merge by May 8 or GA slips. If merge delays past May 9 we should move NA to May 27.
harper (marketplace): I'll prepare placeholder SKU listing templates and a caveats field for region-specific performance. ETA May 6.
sylvia (solutions): I'll draft SI dry-run checklist and perf baselines by May 2. Also request two dedicated staging days: May 13 & May 20.
announce-bot: Reminder: embargoed assets must be uploaded to secure drive 48h before partner packet release.
nana3 (noise): sorry accidental ping
ana (vendor-liaison): Action recap: vendor microcode commit by May 10 (ana), kernel merge by May 8 (kevin), marketplace templates May 6 (harper), SI checklist May 2 (sylvia). If all green: NA May 20, EU Jun 3, APAC Jun 17.
tom (partnerships): I'll coordinate partner packet owners & loop in press-ops/legal in a follow-up thread. :thumbsup:
